To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Bloom filters can be used to achieve efficient and flexible content-based routing in a publish/subscribe system, and 2) a fully decoupled publish/subscribe system with Bloom filter based routing, implemented in Java, can achieve very high performance, and can be easily extended and configured.
Bloom filter based content-based routing is efficient, flexible and decoupled.

(1) we have designed a novel content-based routing scheme, based on Bloom-filters, that achieves high efficiency and flexibility, (2) we have implemented the resulting scheme in a publish/subscribe system and (3) we have evaluated our scheme with respect to efficiency, scalability and flexibility.
In summary, our research is concerned with
efficient and expressive routing in publish/ subscribe systems.
the design, implementation, and evaluation of a publish/subscribe system based on Bloom filters for routing.
the design of an efficient and expressive routing method for content-based publish subscribe systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Bloom filter based routing method is a novel, efficient, flexible and decoupled contentbased publish/subscribe routing method.
our approach achieves high efficiency, high expressiveness and high flexibility in a fully decoupled manner.
the presented approach provides an efficient and flexible routing scheme for content-based publish subscribe systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a novel routing scheme for content-based publish-subscribe systems.
we have shown how to efficiently implement a content-based pub/sub system using Bloom filters.
we present a novel content-based routing scheme that achieves high efficiency while preserving the flexibility of a content-based scheme.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Bloom filters are an efficient and expressive tool for routing in publish/ subscribe systems.
Bloom filters are a powerful tool for content-based routing, especially in combination with a decoupled architecture.
Bloom filters provide a very powerful abstraction for content-based routing.
